Create one production concept image for the Career World project landmark "Tanium Risk Assessment". This is a supporting project building: highly detailed and distinctive, but clearly smaller and less ceremonial than an employer city capital. Research-grounded domain summary: An endpoint-risk assessment and remediation-reporting pipeline evolved from an inherited proof of concept through two Python refactors and a later Go platform migration, with emphasis on collection, analysis efficiency, compact output, and maintainable product integration. Accepted baseline identity: A diagonal escarpment of three interlocked wedge halls steps upward toward one cantilevered audit tower, cut by a deep zigzag inspection trench and anchored by a low triangular forecourt.

Exploration 1 — Canonical Amplification: refine and amplify the accepted baseline geometry while preserving its defining silhouette. Specifically emphasize this researched quality: endpoint inventory collection. Represent team-led evolution rather than solo authorship; do not expose scoring logic, customer data, or private implementation details.

One isolated complete asset in exact orthographic 2.5D isometric perspective, viewed from above at a consistent three-quarter angle. Grayscale only: neutral black, white, and gray with no color tint. Dark near-black technical drafting background with a faint isometric grid. Restrained architectural wireframe line art, matte low-value faces, crisp traced edges, fine parallel construction lines, controlled dense detail, no glow. One image only: no second panel, thumbnails, inset, silhouette swatch, contact sheet, before/after, or detached props. Center the whole coherent structure with generous margin. All roofs, stairs, bridges, annexes, and masses must be buildable and physically connected.
